Cadence Tuesday and Thursday Rides

Milwaukee, WI · Bay View / Fox Point · Road

No-drop

Cadence Tuesday and Thursday Rides is a road group ride in Milwaukee, WI. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 6:00 pm from Bay View Wheel & Sprocket (Tue) / Fox Point Wheel & Sprocket (Thu). About 20 miles, group 1: 15+ mph (drop). Group 2: 13–14 mph, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @cadencemke the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cadence Tuesday and Thursday Rides group ride

Two evening shop rides a week, about 20 miles each. The faster group drops; the second group holds 13–14 mph and waits for the slowest rider. Helmet, rear light, flat kit and a loaded route required. No e-bikes.
